message.content:
In this repo (/home/sirfaenor/Progetti/www/cesar.it/cesar.it), I need to find:
1. The "news" listing page template (likely a Blade/Livewire view) where news items are shown with images - probably a grid of news cards with an aspect-ratio class on the image.
2. The homepage section showing news (a "fascia news" / news strip/carousel) with its image aspect-ratio classes, to use as reference.

Search for files containing "aspect-" (tailwind aspect-ratio classes like aspect-video, aspect-square, aspect-[...]) combined with "news" in the filename or in nearby context (alt text, loop variables like $news, $articolo, $article). Also check for any .aspect-ratio css classes in scss/css files.

Report back:
- Exact file paths for both the news listing page and the homepage news section
- The exact current aspect-ratio class/value used in each (e.g. aspect-video, aspect-[4/3], aspect-[16/9], or CSS padding-bottom hacks)
- The surrounding image markup (img tag or picture tag with classes) for both, with line numbers

Do not make any edits, just report findings.
